description: An Inter-Corporate War era command and surveillance ship, the Bedbug-class was once responsible for coordinating and supplying small Gorlex Marauders task forces in the field. However, following the Ramzi Clique's formation, large numbers of these ships - ignored during demilitarisation - broke away and have been coordinating Clique cells across the vastness of space ever since. While lightly-armed and declining in numbers, the Bedbug-class remains an incredibly capable asset if maintained and utilised properly.
